items.headline: Wembanyama just did something nobody's done since 1998
items.body: Victor Wembanyama went supernova in San Antonio's 112-111 squeaker over Dallas — 52 points, 24 rebounds and 8 blocks, becoming the first player since the '97-98 season to post 25-10-5 in a single half. The Spurs have now won six straight.
items.say: Did you catch Wemby's stat line? 52 and 24 with 8 blocks — that's a cheat code.

items.headline: Fenerbahçe stun Liverpool and end their perfect run
items.body: Liverpool led twice in Istanbul and still walked away empty-handed, losing 3-2 as Vedat Muriqi's 79th-minute header sealed it. The wild part: Fenerbahçe's interim boss is former Red Dirk Kuyt. It's Liverpool's first league-phase defeat.
items.say: Liverpool lost 3-2 at Fenerbahçe — and the guy who masterminded it is Dirk Kuyt. Football's funny.

items.headline: Como hang NINE on Lens in a record rout
items.body: Cesc Fàbregas' Como put on a show you almost never see in Europe's top competition, thrashing Lens 9-1 with Nico Paz pulling the strings. It's one of the most lopsided scorelines in Champions League history.
items.say: A Champions League team won 9-1 last night. Nine! When's the last time you saw that?

items.headline: Gen.G sweep North America's LYON to reach a third straight semi
items.body: Gen.G rolled LYON 3-0 in Allen, Texas to book their third consecutive Worlds semifinal — and send the last North American team home. Next up: a blockbuster clash with TheShy's Invictus Gaming on Friday.
items.say: Gen.G just 3-0'd the last NA team at Worlds. They keep reaching the final four but never win it — this their year?

items.headline: Antonelli's first race weekend as champ is in Brazil
items.body: Fresh off becoming F1's youngest-ever world champion, Kimi Antonelli heads to Interlagos for the São Paulo Grand Prix this weekend (race Sunday). Expect a party atmosphere at one of the sport's most electric circuits.
items.say: F1's new teenage champ races in Brazil this weekend — Interlagos always delivers chaos.

items.headline: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' stomps into theaters Friday
items.body: The follow-up to the Oscar-winning 'Godzilla Minus One' gets its wide North American release Friday from GKIDS. If the trailer's any hint, the King of the Monsters has never looked bigger — go for the IMAX.
items.say: The new Godzilla opens Friday — the last one won an Oscar for effects. You seeing it?

items.headline: Lil Baby drops his fifth album 'FRESH' on Friday
items.body: The Atlanta star's new 17-track record lands Friday with features from Future, Young Thug and Rylo Rodriguez. The Pharrell-produced lead single 'Dead Fresh' has been setting the table all fall.
items.say: New Lil Baby album Friday — and Pharrell produced the lead single. Been a minute since his last one.

items.headline: 'The Rings of Power' returns for Season 3 next week
items.body: Amazon's billion-dollar Middle-earth epic is back November 11 on Prime Video, with the trailer teasing the long-awaited rise of a certain grey wizard. A good excuse to rewatch before it drops.
items.say: Rings of Power Season 3 is almost here — looks like we finally meet Gandalf. You still watching?

items.headline: Awkwafina learns to cook (badly) in a new Apple TV show
items.body: 'Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook' starts streaming Friday on Apple TV — the comedian fumbling her way around a kitchen she fully admits she can't handle. Easy, funny weekend watch.
items.say: There's a new Awkwafina cooking show where the whole joke is she can't cook. Sounds like my kitchen.
